payload.title: Add create-github-issue Cursor skill and cross-links
payload.body:
## Summary

Adds a **create-github-issue** Cursor skill that standardizes GitHub issue titles and bodies (Summary, Scope, Acceptance criteria, Dependencies, Notes) and documents **`gh issue create`** with **`--body-file`** and temp files outside the clone. **open-github-pr**, **prd-to-tickets**, and **git-town-stacked-changes** link to it so agents draft consistent issues before PRs.

## Scope

- In scope: New `.cursor/skills/create-github-issue/SKILL.md`; cross-links in **open-github-pr**, **prd-to-tickets**, and **git-town-stacked-changes**; **open-github-pr** frontmatter description update.
- Out of scope: New Cursor rules; changes outside `.cursor/skills/`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New skill exists with copy-paste template, `gh` workflow (defer auth to open-github-pr step 1), and quality checklist.
- [ ] **open-github-pr**, **prd-to-tickets**, and **git-town-stacked-changes** reference **create-github-issue** where issues are drafted or exported to GitHub.
- [ ] Relative skill links resolve within `.cursor/skills/`.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none
- Blocks: none
